source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Heater and Air Conditioning, p.1A-7

procedures.title: Defroster duct: remove and install
steps: Remove the screws holding the defroster duct to the firewall and carefully lower the duct out of the car.

procedures.title: Bowden cables: adjust
steps: With the cables connected to the control levers, move the levers fully left (closed).
Move the matching distributor duct door to its fully off position.
Attach the cable wire to the duct door lever and tighten the cable bracket screws.
Check that the cable works properly.
notes: 1968 Corvette uses a new plastic bowden cable.

procedures.title: Blower switch: remove and install
steps: Do steps 1-3 of the Corvette control head removal.
Remove the screws holding the blower switch to the control assembly and take out the switch.

procedures.title: Blower resistor: remove and install
steps: Disconnect the wire at the resistor.
Remove the two screws holding the resistor to the distributor duct and remove it.
Install the new resistor in reverse order.
notes: The glove box removal step applies to all models except Corvette.
